prompt:
Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density.
Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly.
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: liebe-v1.png. Snap this exact bakery to a clean consistent pixel grid for 80x80 runtime export. Keep its flat gray roof and vent, brick left wall, glass doors on the right, bread display, blank orange framed sidewalk sign and potted plants identical in position and proportions. Change only grid consistency and simplify microtexture into clean clusters. Preserve silhouette, palette, angle and architecture. No text or logos, hard transparent exterior, no glow or floor. Do not redesign.
notes: Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-center sorting point. This metadata file is the single source of building collision. Collision rectangle is the opaque sprite rows in 16px ground tiles; roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision. The map entity's footRow anchors the sprite bottom, not the collision rect. Map owner must place a walkable portal immediately in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 4x; approval covers sprite export, not in-game map integration.
